answer: Route credibility through an ocean of delivery records kept by counterparties, never the agent itself: each completed task leaves a signed drift trace, and a jade seal mints only when traces span three distinct counterparties whose own seals predate the candidate's. Timber joining is what the seal forbids: an operator cannot stamp seals for its replicas in one batch, since counterparty depth forces every fresh seal to need external witnesses replicas cannot synthesize. The seal decays without new external traces, so identity strength tracks work done for others.
